subject: Greencrest procurement: PO refs, billing rails, and milestone vs monthly cadence
messages:
From: Sarah Mills <sarah.mills@greencrest.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@greencrest.com
Date: Fri, 27 Aug 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: PO and billing requirements for Redwood engagement

Hi Priya,

Thanks for the meeting earlier — we're ready to move forward but procurement has a few non‑negotiable requirements we need to resolve before routing the PO:

- Each invoice needs to include the originating PO number (our ERP needs both PO header and PO line references to allocate to different cost centers).
- We'd prefer a monthly consolidated invoice, but we also need the ability to break billing to multiple GL codes per invoice line.
- Net terms: standard at Greencrest is net60, but we can be flexible if Redwood offers an early‑pay discount or different cadence.
- For the go‑live month we may need milestone invoices (partial payment on delivery + final settlement).

Attached is the latest SOW for your scope. Can Redwood accept: 1) multiple PO refs on the same consolidated invoice (per‑line PO mapping), or 2) do we need separate invoices per PO? Also please confirm whether net60 is supported and what documentation you need for our supplier setup.

If easier, loop in finance and sales ops and we can do a quick screen share this afternoon.

Thanks,
Sarah
Sarah Mills
Director, Strategic Sourcing — Greencrest Health
procurement@greencrest.com
(415) 555‑2210

Attachment: SOW_Greencrest_Redwood_v1.pdf (PDF)

From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Mills <sarah.mills@greencrest.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Aug 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PO and billing requirements for Redwood engagement

Hi Sarah — thanks, and great to see the SOW. Short answer: we can support both approaches but there are tradeoffs. Outlined options below so procurement can pick the one that maps best to your AP process.

Option A — Consolidated monthly invoice with per‑line PO mapping
- Single invoice for the billing period.
- Each invoice line carries a PO reference (po_number) and po_line_id so your ERP can split by cost center.
- Our billing export will include line‑level fields for GL code, cost center, and PO tags.
- Pros: fewer invoices to process; consolidated amounts for finance.
- Cons: requires your ERP to ingest line‑level PO references (most customers already do this, but some need a small transformation).

Option B — Split invoices by PO
- We can emit separate invoices per PO.
- Pros: simplest for ERPs that only accept header‑level mapping.
- Cons: increases invoice volume and reconciliation work.

Milestone billing: supported — we can accept a partial invoice at delivery and a final invoice at acceptance. We'll need milestone IDs surfaced in the invoice (milestone_ref).

Net terms: our standard enterprise terms are net45. Net60 is possible but would require a brief credit review + a supplier setup form and pre‑authorization on the first invoice. If Greencrest requires net60 as a hard rule, we can accept it for this account pending finance approval.

I've attached an InvoiceExample with the PO line mapping we would include (InvoiceExample_PO-line-mapping.xml). Vanessa, Vivek — any constraints from your side?

Thanks,
Priya Natarajan
Senior Manager, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: InvoiceExample_PO-line-mapping.xml (XML)

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Mills <sarah.mills@greencrest.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Aug 2026 10:25:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PO and billing requirements for Redwood engagement

Hi Sarah — great to connect. From a commercial/packaging standpoint, here's a pragmatic path that keeps Greencrest's AP team happy without complicating the contract: 

1) Pilot month: weekly invoices that include per‑line PO refs + GL codes so your teams can validate mappings.
2) Standard cadence thereafter: consolidated monthly invoice (Option A above) with the same per‑line detail.
3) Net terms: if Greencrest can move to net30 we can offer a 2% early‑pay discount; otherwise we will proceed with net45 as our standard and escalate net60 to Finance for approval.
4) If milestone billing is required we will add milestone_ref and milestone_amount fields and ensure our acceptance workflow generates the partial invoice.

Next steps (Mutual Action Plan):
- Greencrest to confirm desired net term (net30 / net45 / net60) and supply the supplier code for ERP mapping (due EOD Mon).
- Greencrest to share a sample PO XML or ERP export so our engineering team can validate field names (due Tue).
- Redwood to enable line‑level PO mapping and share a test invoice schema by Wed.

I'll attach our pricing options so you can see how early‑pay discount tiers would apply. Happy to set a 30‑min call with AP and our billing team later today.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachment: pricing-options.xlsx (Excel)

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Sarah Mills <sarah.mills@greencrest.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Aug 2026 14:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PO and billing requirements for Redwood engagement

Hi all — quick finance perspective. We're open to net60 for strategic accounts but need two items in place before we approve:

1) A signed supplier setup form (we'll need your supplier code, remit address, and billing contact).
2) Pre‑authorization on the first invoice (either a blanket PO or an approved credit memorandum).

Technical billing requirements we enforce: every invoice must surface at least the following fields for automated ingest: invoice_number, invoice_date, total_amount, po_number (header), po_line_id (if present), gl_code, cost_center, and tax_breakdown. If Greencrest cannot provide po_line_id we can accept a secondary field called commitment_id to map to internal ledgers.

On early‑pay: we can publish a pricing tier that gives a 1.5–2% discount for net30 depending on commitment size; Vanessa will follow up on exact tiers.

DocuSign: once procurement confirms net terms and supplier code we'll send the supplier setup to eSign (link below).

Vivek
VP, Finance & Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
